function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

• Live music on multiple stages, cultural workshops, and food vendors | ### Why SXSW is the “next” festival to watch - **Timing** – It’s the first major festival of the year that’s already announced and scheduled for 2025, so tickets and travel plans are already in motion. - **Scope** – SXSW is a multi‑disciplinary event that attracts artists, filmmakers, tech innovators, and media professionals, making it a hub for networking and discovery. - **Accessibility** – Austin is a major city with a robust transportation network, plenty of accommodation options, and a vibrant nightlife scene that extends beyond the festival itself. --- ## 📅 How to Stay Updated | Resource | What to Look For | Why It Helps | |----------|------------------|--------------| | **Official Festival Websites** | Ticket release dates, lineup announcements, travel packages | Direct source of accurate, up‑to‑date info | | **Social Media (Twitter, Instagram)** | #SXSW, #Coachella, #JazzFest | Real‑time updates, behind‑the‑scenes content | | **Ticketing Platforms (Ticketmaster, Eventbrite)** | Ticket availability, presale codes | Early access to tickets and exclusive offers | | **Travel Blogs & Forums (Lonely Planet, Reddit r/festivals)** | Insider tips, budget hacks, travel itineraries | Practical advice from people who’ve been there | --- ## 🚀 Quick Action Checklist 1. **Check the official SXSW website** for the latest lineup and ticket sale dates. 2. **Sign up for email alerts** from Ticketmaster or the festival’s own mailing list. 3. **Book flights and accommodations** early—Austin is a popular destination, and prices rise as the event approaches. 4. **Plan your itinerary**: decide which stages or events you want to attend, and map out a rough schedule. 5. **Pack smart**: bring layers, a reusable water bottle, and a portable phone charger. --- ### Final Thought If you’re looking for a festival that’s both culturally rich and logistically convenient, SXSW is the next big thing to keep an eye on. It’s early enough in the year that you can lock in travel plans, but it’s also fresh enough that the buzz is still building—perfect timing for a memorable experience.
